simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לָעֵג (H3934) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לָעֵג (lâʻêg) means a buffoon ; also a foreigner First listed occurrence: Isa 28 11.

definitions.full: H3934. laeg [ לָעֵג ] adjective mocking , only plural construct as noun (si vera lectio), מָעוֺג לַעֲגֵי Psa 35:16 mockers of מָעוֺג (q. v.), but text dubious; Che reads לֹעֲגֵי Schw ZAW xi. 1890, 258 לָֽעֲגוּ . — To [ לָעֵג ] is also reffered לַעֲגֵי Isa 28:11 by Ges De Che Du, < below לַעַג q. v.
